claims.manuscript_safe_claim: Within-model cross-representation summaries demonstrate representation-dependent anomaly-ranking behaviour.
claims.prohibited_stronger_interpretation: Any representation is universally more accurate, higher-performing, or scientifically superior.

claims.manuscript_safe_claim: The five named robustness scenarios exhibit different descriptive rank concordance and displacement.
claims.prohibited_stronger_interpretation: Smaller displacement establishes detector accuracy or scientific correctness.

claims.manuscript_safe_claim: IF, LOF, and AE show strong but non-identical pairwise and global rank agreement.
claims.prohibited_stronger_interpretation: Independent confirmation of true or physical anomalies.

claims.manuscript_safe_claim: Frozen top-k overlap varies across the predefined k values 3, 5, and 10.
claims.prohibited_stronger_interpretation: Top-k defines an anomaly class or threshold.

claims.manuscript_safe_claim: EPIC 60018238, EPIC 60018678, and EPIC 60042292 are selected robust-high-consensus inspection candidates.
claims.prohibited_stronger_interpretation: Confirmed anomaly, new discovery, validated phenomenon, or new class.

claims.manuscript_safe_claim: Graph representations provide complementary spectral relational context through retained-peak topology, typed relationships, and operational-reference-centred local relational neighbourhoods.
claims.prohibited_stronger_interpretation: Physical novelty, mechanism, object classification, peak-level candidate status, or unsupported cross-object common-neighbour claims.
